newsitem.title: CHINA: China grain reserve reach all-time high.
newsitem.headline: China grain reserve reach all-time high.

text.p: China's grain reserves stand at an all-time record high, Vice-Premier Zhu Rongji said on Tuesday.
He added that officials needed to ensure payments to farmers at proper prices to maintain harvests.

China has reported a bumper summer harvest for the third consecutive year, resulting in a drop in grain prices in some places, the Xinhua news agency quoted Zhu as telling a conference on agriculture.
To ensure farmers continued to plant grain, Zhu told officials involved in state grain output to purchase grain at appropriate prices.

Zhu, who is in charge of China's economy, urged localities at all levels to publicise the fact that the government would purchase farmers' fixed quotas of grain at prices set by the State Council, or cabinet, last year, Xinhua said.
In some areas, local authorities have this year been buying grain intended to meet government quotas at market prices, which are currently lower than state prices, officials have said.

Grain exceeding fixed quotas will be purchased at protective prices, or standard prices set by the State Council, Zhu told the conference. Standard prices are slightly lower than state-set quota prices but currently still higher than prices farmers can achieve for their grain on the free market .
Officials have forecast China's summer grain harvest at 115-118 million tonnes, up from 111 million last year.
The Ministry of Internal Trade has forecast grain output for this year at above 484 million tonnes, compared with a record 490 million tonnes last year.
As a result of the record harvests, China's grain reserves now stood at an all-time high, Zhu said. He gave no figure for the size of China's grain reserves, which is a state secret.
A national conference on agriculture issued a call to departments nationwide to try their best to keep autumn grain production at the same level as last year, Xinhua said.
However, officials warned of possible unfavourable weather conditions for autumn grain production. They gave no details.
